_comment: What the coverage gate (Tools/coverage_gate.py) measures. A file counts when its repository-relative path starts with an `include` root and matches no `exclude` pattern. Every exclusion carries its reason; an adapter may only be listed once all of its decisions live in a tested type (see CLAUDE.md, 'Coverage gate').

exclude.reason: SwiftUI view bodies; exercised by KurnUITests flows, not measured by the gate. Presentation logic is extracted to a pure type below Views/ so it counts.
Root SwiftUI view (split view / sheet host); same rule as Kurn/Views.
DEBUG-only seed data and fault-injection hooks; test glue, compiled out of Release.
App Intents run only from Siri/Shortcuts; no test target executes them yet (docs/testing-coverage-plan.md, Fase 4).
